criteria.name: Field as an object
criteria.answer: In a sharp stationary field state the body evolves exactly by an effective contract with the profile as a position-dependent factor, its view stays pure and a reduced admissible description exists; a field that is not sharp acts as a mixture of such evolutions.

criteria.name: Clock rate in a field
criteria.answer: The rate at a place is set by the factor on the clock term (η_x/λ₀ for a wide start); the ratio of two rates from two runs at equal λ is well defined, the ratio of the parameters is not.

criteria.name: Free fall
criteria.answer: A body in one branch falls from rest with (τ_k²/M_k)(σF_k − G_k) at first order in the gradients; the fall depends on the rest term, the level and the speed unless the gradients are tuned.

criteria.name: Universality of free fall
criteria.answer: The fall from rest is level-independent iff (τ_k²/M_k)(F_k − G_k) is; on both branches iff the field multiplies the whole rest and clock term and adds no plain gradient; a common clock response and a level-independent fall do not imply each other.

criteria.name: Clock rate and fall
criteria.answer: Where the fall is level-independent and not zero it equals −(v_max²/d₀)(r(x+1) − r(x))/r(x), with only the maximal speed, the distance and the two rates, at first order in the gradients.

criteria.name: Limits of universality
criteria.answer: Exact only at rest and first order: the lattice adds a level-dependent v² term, superposed levels fall with the mean, records act at orders κ² and κ³, a constant under the factor breaks universality, and a curved profile gives the local result only in a limit.

criteria.name: Bodies of different types
criteria.answer: Two types fall alike and their clocks respond alike per distance under separate conditions; with level-independent falls any two of fall alike, respond alike and common maximal speed imply the third; equal falls need ⟨X⟩ = 0.

criteria.name: Fields that are not sharp
criteria.answer: A static unsharp field acts as a mixture over its sectors; a field with its own contract gives the mean profile with level-dependent corrections; a changing field gives the same fall for all levels at every frequency iff the start has no position–label correlation.

criteria.name: Composite bodies
criteria.answer: No, in this description: a bound pair falls like its parts at no fixed binding, its fall depends on the clock levels, its inertia does not follow its cost and its binding cost is not weighed like the rest cost; only the ordered wide-pair limit restores agreement.

criteria.name: Typical or forced
criteria.answer: In a five-parameter class of couplings the universal ones are exceptional (codimension 1 to 4), broken at first order by a deviation, and selected by one well-defined requirement on the effective blocks that the language does not enforce.
